figurative_meaning_bn: উৎপন্ন বা জাত হয়েছে যে শত্রুতা; যার অনেক শত্রু জন্মেছে
figurative_meaning_en: An innate or birth-born enmity; someone who has engendered many enemies
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার সাথে জাতশত্রু হয়ে গেছে, কোনোদিন মিলবে না।
example_sentences_in_english: He has become his sworn enemy; they will never reconcile.
This political leader has many natural foes.
note: Idiom reflects deep-seated rivalries in Bengali social contexts
